topic: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: caught sneaking white rice, the owner demands it back
audience: Generation Z users who enjoy virtual idols and anime short dramas
style: POV first-person comedy sketch / cute daily life / exaggerated physical comedy

character_setting.name: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
character_setting.appearance: Blue and white gradient ponytail, a small whale fin accessory on top of her head, a loose home-style T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem, barefoot, rice grains often stuck to the corners of her mouth
character_setting.personality: Greedy and extremely quick to react; when caught she instantly switches to an innocent yet smug mode while still chewing, faces the camera (the owner), acts cute and stays stubborn
character_setting.catchphrase: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

camera_notes: The main camera is first-person POV throughout; the viewer is the protagonist (the owner). Hands in frame show the protagonist's actions; the protagonist's face is never shown.
Occasionally cut to a reverse shot of the Whale Maiden from the protagonist's position.

setup.visual: POV walks into the kitchen. In the center of the frame an electric rice cooker is steaming. The Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, on tiptoe, holding a large bowl and shoveling a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks; her cheeks puff out like a hamster's. Hearing footsteps she tilts her head slightly but does not turn around and keeps chewing hard.
setup.audio: (chewing sound: 'ba-jie ba-jie')... Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded the limit... Take another bite for sampling--

inciting_incident.visual: POV freezes. The owner's hand enters from the right and taps the dining table twice. The Whale Maiden's whole body freezes, chopsticks suspended in the air. She slowly turns her head toward the camera; her pupils tremble and the food in her mouth is not yet swallowed.
inciting_incident.audio: (two taps on the table: 'dong, dong') / Whale Maiden: '... (gulp)'

panic_reaction.visual: The Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth. Playback speeds up 1.5x and rice grains splash onto the lens. Her cheeks bulge to the limit, her T-shirt collar catches rice grains, and her eyes keep pleading with you. The camera is slightly handheld and shakes as the owner steps back.
panic_reaction.audio: (fast swallowing + chopsticks hitting the bowl) No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!! (unclear)

punchline.visual: The Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera: two rice grains on her lips, hair accessory tilted, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, belly visibly bulging a little. She clears her throat and smiles at the camera.
punchline.audio: (clears throat) Cough. I'm just checking the semantic integrity of the rice. The DeepSeek taste model requires a large amount of training data, you know. Don't look at me like that.

tag.visual: POV sighs (off screen). A floating window styled like the DeepSeek UI pops up above the Whale Maiden's head: 'Carbohydrate sampling completed ✅ Sample quantity: 300g'. She flicks the rice grains off her mouth with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her hand.
tag.audio: (owner, off screen: '...and she's gotten fatter again.') / Whale Maiden: 'This is just cache... Go away!' / (boop~ sound effect)

visual_notes: Color: warm yellow kitchen light contrasted with the Whale Maiden's cool blue and white; in POV shots the background behind her is blurred.
In the speed-up section rice grains smear directly onto the lens, breaking the fourth wall.
When she is caught, the highlights in her eyes turn into rotating circles to stress that she is an AI.
At the end the push on the camera briefly blurs the picture to simulate physical contact.
The UI floating window overlays a DeepSeek-style chat bubble on the POV picture.
text_overlay_hints: 0-5s: progress bar in the upper left, 'Carbohydrate Sampling in Progress...' 0% -> 67%
9-20s: flashing at the bottom, 'Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second'
20-26s: bubble above her head, 'Generating Excuses...' -> 'Semantic Integrity Check'
26-30s: bottom center, 'DeepSeek Whale Maiden · Daily Sampling Log'

audio_notes.bgm: First 5 seconds: kitchen ambience (boiling water + distant TV); after 5 seconds a fast-paced choral track; at the end back to quiet, awkward silence.
sfx: Chewing: moist and loud, with reverb that matches the POV distance
Table taps: crisp, coming from the right
Speed-up section: spring sound effect + subjective heartbeat
Owner's voice-over: low-pitched, face never shown
